difficolta.help: Measured by the technique the puzzle actually needs, not by how many numbers are printed. Easy solves with obvious moves, Medium needs locked candidates or pairs, Hard needs more than that. Changing this starts a new grid.

nuovaPartita.help: Builds a fresh puzzle at the difficulty above. Every grid is generated on the spot and always has exactly one solution.

cancellaTutto.help: Wipes what you wrote and restarts the clock. The printed numbers stay.

mostraAiuti.help: Turns a number red when it repeats in its row, column or box, and flashes the numbers it clashes with.

dimensioneGriglia.help: Share of the shorter screen side taken by the grid.

spazioBasso.help: Pixels kept free along the bottom edge so the taskbar does not cover the control bar. The grid is centred in what is left. Set 0 if your taskbar hides itself, raise it on a scaled display.

raggioLuce.help: How far the warm halo around the cursor reaches. When the mouse rests, the halo drifts on its own.

mostraBarra.text: Show the control bar on the desktop
mostraBarra.help: The faint row at the bottom of the screen. Turn it off to keep the desktop clean and use this panel instead.
